title: The Planting of the Moon-Seed
causes: The gift of the sacred moon-seed from the primordial Narmada Man at the Crystal Spire
outcomes: The rapid, brilliant blooming of the massive Bhuta-Kāna Tree
The healing of the Godavari rainforest's ecological blight
The creation of a living, mycelial archive of ancestral memory
summary: Upon returning to the Godavari rainforests, Jambanson plants the sacred moon-seed received from the Narmada Man. The seed rapidly blossoms into the silver-glowing Bhuta-Kāna Tree, restoring the ecosystem.
sources: Roots and Whispers: The Legacy of the Bhuta-Kāna Tree
